capabilities: Convert an hourly rate into a pay table
Convert an annual salary into a pay table
Compare multiple rates side by side with difference rows
Insert the generated table at the cursor
Prefill hours and days per week from settings
extras: Not listed in the Community Plugins directory; install manually by copying main.js and manifest.json into .obsidian/plugins/salary-calculator/. Commands require an open note in editing view, otherwise they stop with an error.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert pay between hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual amounts or to compare several rates in a note.
summary: Calculator that converts an hourly rate or annual salary into a pay breakdown table inserted at the cursor, with side-by-side rate comparison.
